# MorrowOS "Dawn" — GRUB boot menu theme
#
# Assets are generated by tools/make_grub_theme.py from tools/dawn_palette.py.
# Do not hand-edit the PNGs; regenerate them.
#
# No *-font properties are declared anywhere in this file, on purpose.
# GRUB can only use fonts converted to its own .pf2 format, and naming a font
# the ISO does not carry makes the whole theme fail to load rather than just
# falling back. The unicode font grub.cfg already loads is legible, and the
# brand is carried by the background and the wordmark instead. If you want
# proper typography later, generate a .pf2 with grub-mkfont into this
# directory and add the item_font / title-font lines then.

desktop-image: "background.png"
desktop-image-scale-method: "stretch"
desktop-color: "#100E1A"

title-text: ""
message-color: "#F3ECE3"
message-bg-color: "#171326"

terminal-left: "8%"
terminal-top: "12%"
terminal-width: "84%"
terminal-height: "72%"

# ── wordmark ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+ image {
    file  = "wordmark.png"
    left  = 50%-172
    top   = 13%
    width = 344
    height = 108
}

# ── menu ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Sits above the horizon rule in the background (70% of height), so the warm
# band reads as ground under the menu rather than behind the text.
+ boot_menu {
    left   = 50%-300
    top    = 34%
    width  = 600
    height = 30%

    item_height  = 38
    item_spacing = 6
    item_padding = 12

    # Ubuntu's menu entries carry no icons; leaving space for them just
    # shifts every label off centre.
    icon_width      = 0
    icon_height     = 0
    item_icon_space = 0

    item_color          = "#F3ECE3"
    selected_item_color = "#14101F"
    selected_item_pixmap_style = "select_*.png"

    scrollbar       = true
    scrollbar_width = 4
    scrollbar_thumb = "select_*.png"
}

# ── timeout countdown ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+ progress_bar {
    id     = "__timeout__"
    left   = 50%-200
    top    = 78%
    width  = 400
    height = 6

    show_text       = false
    bar_style       = "progress_bar_*.png"
    highlight_style = "progress_hl_*.png"
}

# ── hint ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
+ label {
    text  = "Use the arrow keys to select, Enter to boot"
    left  = 0
    top   = 88%
    width = 100%
    align = "center"
    color = "#A497A8"
}
